faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Chief Manager (Legal) post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Chief Manager (Legal) position at the Shipping Corporation of India is 13-10-2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for this role?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a full-time Bachelor's Degree in Law or a Post Graduate Degree in Law from a college approved by the Bar Council of India, with at least 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Chief Manager (Legal) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Chief Manager (Legal) post in the Shipping Corporation of India recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Chief Manager (Legal) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Chief Manager (Legal) post is 45 years as on 01-08-2026. Age relaxation is applicable as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Chief Manager (Legal) role?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Chief Manager (Legal) post is as per IDA pay revision, ranging from Rs. 90,000 to Rs. 2,40,000.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of thirteen (13) years of post-qualification experience in a Corporate Legal Department is required for the Chief Manager (Legal) position.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Chief Manager (Legal) recruitment?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of the Shipping Corporation of India. A physical copy of the application also needs to be submitted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for the Chief Manager (Legal) post?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1,000/- for General, OBC, and EWS categories, and Rs. 500/- (intimation charges) for SC/ST/PwBD/ExSM categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on eligibility criteria, followed by Document Verification and an In-person Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It contains all detailed information about the recruitment.
